verdict.rationale: RudderStack's MCP server is explicitly scoped to operational/observability tasks—debugging delivery errors, monitoring pipelines, writing/testing transformations, reviewing tracking plans and audit logs (docs-13/14/15/16/48/52/53)—with no documented capability to query customer data or create/activate audiences via API or MCP. Audience building/activation (docs-6, docs-27, docs-38) is only described as a dashboard/product feature, not exposed through the documented API surface (docs-33, docs-47) or MCP tool list.
